fact: On 18 January 2024 the Minister of Finance issued Circular No. 001 setting how central-government taxes, duties and fees (DGI, DGDA, DGRAD) may be paid through digital channels, with banks and e-money institutions authorised to collect them.
title: Modalités d’utilisation des canaux digitaux dans le processus de paiement des recettes fiscales, non fiscales et douanières en RD-Congo
